# Tcl/Tk upstream license notices

Windows beta 1 bundles Tcl/Tk 8.6.15; both macOS beta 1 builds bundle Tcl/Tk 8.6.16. The files below are unmodified upstream `license.terms` files and are copied to future release packages even when a Python installation omits them.

- `Tcl-8.6.15-license.terms`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tcltk/tcl/core-8-6-15/license.terms
- `Tk-8.6.15-license.terms`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tcltk/tk/core-8-6-15/license.terms
- `Tcl-8.6.16-license.terms`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tcltk/tcl/core-8-6-16/license.terms
- `Tk-8.6.16-license.terms`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tcltk/tk/core-8-6-16/license.terms
